title: RFC 8865 T.140 WebRTC data-channel boundary
scope: Validates generic RFC 8865 T.140 data-channel properties and T140block content carriage. It does not implement SCTP, DTLS, browser APIs, SDP dcmap negotiation, channel reestablishment, flow control, or complete RFC 8865 conformance.

basis: the T.140 data-channel subprotocol identifier is t140
application-level redundancy and reordering are unnecessary on the reliable ordered data channel
the default cps value is 30 when no cps parameter is present
T.140 text is encoded and framed as T140blocks
one or more T140blocks can be sent in a single SCTP user message
the recommended default transmission interval is 300 ms
after channel reestablishment the sender must not retransmit prior T140blocks
the receiver should indicate possible text loss and may use the T.140 missing-text marker

deferred: DTLS and WebRTC browser API integration
language negotiation with hlang-send and hlang-recv
